jobs.title: Senior Consultant Konzernkunden / Strategieberatung (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Worum geht's? Du hast bei KPMG, BCG, McKinsey, Bain oder einer vergleichbaren Beratung gelernt, wie man auf Vorstandsebene überzeugt, komplexe Transformationen strukturiert und unter Druck liefert. Und du hast gemerkt: Die Decks werden größer, die Hierarchien länger, dein Impact auf die eigentliche Entscheidung wird kleiner. Up-or-out, 60-Stunden-Wochen für die Marke eines anderen, drei Freigabeschleifen bevor du mit dem Mandanten überhaupt sprechen darfst. Bei SC Ventures drehen wir das um: Du übernimmst eigene Mandate bei etablierten Unternehmen mit wachsender Komplexität und sprichst direkt mit der Geschäftsführung oder dem Vorstand. Keine Pyramide dazwischen. Keine drei Partner, die sich vorher abstimmen müssen. Was du bei einer Big4/MBB-Beratung an Struktur, Methodik und Executive-Kommunikation gelernt hast, bringst du zu uns – und wirst gleichzeitig daran beteiligt, was du aufbaust: Sobald deine Bestandskunden verlängern, bekommst du eine vertraglich geregelte Umsatzbeteiligung. Kein Bonus-Pool, keine Politik – dein Ergebnis, deine Beteiligung. Wir sind kein Konzern. Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes Team, das im Bildungssektor bereits über 100 Träger jährlich betreut – Mandate, die von etablierten Bildungsträgern mit mehreren Standorten über wachsende Mittelständler bis hin zu Konzernmandaten reichen. Du gestaltest mit, wie dieser Bereich strukturiert wird, nicht nur, wie er ausgeführt wird. Aufgaben Was dich erwartet: Du verantwortest eigenständig Beratungsmandate für Unternehmen mit wachsender Größe und Komplexität – von der Ansprache auf Geschäftsführungs-/Vorstandsebene bis zur Umsetzungssteuerung Du entwickelst Geschäfts- und Betriebsmodelle für Vertriebs- und CRM-Transformation und verantwortest deren Umsetzung – nicht nur die Folie dazu Du führst Strategie-Workshops und Steering-Committees auf C-Level-Niveau Du baust gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung die methodische Basis für den Enterprise-Bereich mit auf: Angebotsstruktur, Delivery-Standards, Qualität

jobs.title: Integration Specialist – Electronic Data Interchange (EDI)
jobs.description: We Want You to Grow With Us We are strengthening our EDI integration capabilities at Intersnack IT. As our next Integration Specialist – EDI, you will bring your experience in electronic data interchange and your understanding of business processes to support reliable transactions between our business units, trading partners and applications. Your knowledge of Order to Cash (O2C) and Source to Pay (S2P) will help you translate business requirements into effective integration solutions. Based in Düsseldorf, you will work closely with our Application Service Delivery & Support and Business Transformation teams, business stakeholders and external EDI providers, supporting both daily operations and international ERP initiatives. What We Can Offer This position combines hands-on EDI development with responsibility for integrations that support our supply chain. You will apply your business process knowledge to practical technical solutions and contribute to global ERP initiatives and local EDI rollouts. If you bring strong EDI expertise and experience with O2C and S2P processes, we can support your onboarding into the Infor M3 integration stack. jobs.title: PR Manager DE
jobs.description: A fight lasts minutes. A great story travels much further. The comeback nobody saw coming. The rivalry that divides an arena. The person behind the fighter, with a story that deserves to reach people who have never watched MMA. At OKTAGON, those stories are everywhere. We’re building a sports brand with international ambitions, passionate fans and events that bring thousands of people together. Germany is a major part of that journey. And we’re looking for a PR Manager who knows how to make our stories matter to German media. Someone who can earn the trust of a sports editor, spot an angle for a business title and understand why a digital format might reach an audience a traditional press release never will. You’ll help decide which stories we tell, who we tell them to and how far they go. Your stories need to travel beyond the cage. Sports media will be your home ground. But your curiosity should take you further. A fighter’s journey can belong in a mainstream interview. Our growth can start a business conversation. Training, personality and culture can open doors to fitness and lifestyle coverage. You’ll find those opportunities and turn them into pitches that give each outlet a reason to care. Here’s what you’ll take ownership of: Build real relationships with German media. Develop and maintain a network across sports, digital and mainstream outlets. Get to know the journalists, their audiences and the stories they actually want. Earn coverage for OKTAGON, our events and our fighters. Create opportunities around upcoming fights and recognise stories that deserve attention outside the event calendar. Find new routes to our audience. Follow how the media landscape is changing, from digital publishers and podcasts to emerging editorial formats. Know where a story will work and adapt it accordingly. Create sharp German press materials. Write press releases, translate and localise event Media Info Cards, research fight cards and prepare tailored angles for individual

jobs.description: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI s operational blind spots into operational clarity. World s leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there s a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet. Value Engineer (Scale team)  The Team: The position of Senior Value Engineer (Scale team) is a trusted advisor responsible for driving value, adoption, and customer success across a portfolio of accounts. We enable customers across defense, law enforcement, and enterprise to turn mission-critical data into actionable intelligence. Role We re looking for a hands-on Solution Architect to join our GovDev team. This is not a pre-sales or slideware role. Roughly half of your time you build: integrating customer data sources into our platform, wiring up pipelines on our data fabric (ODFF), and shipping demo-grade frontends. The other half you spend with customers and our product teams, making sure what we promise is what the platform can do, and what the platform can t do yet lands on the roadmap. What you ll do Act as technical lead on incoming opportunities: run discovery calls, qualify technical fit against the platform s current state, answer architecture, integration and security questions, and own the technical part of pitches, demos and workshops. Build prototypes yourself: ingest a customer s data (files, APIs, message exports, sensor feeds, geodata) through our ingest layer, model it into our universal record and entity schema, and expose it in the platform frontend or a purpose-built demo UI. jobs.title: Senior National Account Manager - Industry & Manufacturing
jobs.description: The Practical Detail Location: Southwark, London Working Model: Hybrid Why this role matters In your first year, you will lead the commercial growth of Flora Professional's Industry & Manufacturing business across the UK and Ireland, driving sustainable revenue growth and securing new strategic partnerships. This role is vital to expanding Flora's presence in key sectors such as bakery, desserts, soups, sauces, and beverages. By combining commercial expertise with culinary innovation, you will help manufacturers create exceptional food products that meet evolving consumer needs. Your work will directly support Flora Food Group's mission to deliver better food solutions that inspire kitchens and delight consumers. What you'll do Lead the execution of Flora Professional's growth strategy across Industry & Manufacturing sectors, identifying new commercial opportunities. Build and maintain trusted partnerships with procurement, commercial, technical, and culinary stakeholders at leading food manufacturers. Collaborate with Culinary, Marketing, Technical, and R&D teams to develop innovative recipes and product applications that showcase Flora's portfolio. Drive commercial excellence through negotiations, joint business planning, pricing discussions, and long-term agreements. Manage and coach a Junior Key Account Manager, fostering a culture of accountability and high performance. Performance You will own the commercial growth of a key business area generating over 45% gross margin in the UK channel. Your data-driven approach and commercial insight will ensure sustainable revenue growth, improved customer engagement, and operational excellence. Success will be measured by your ability to meet growth targets, secure new partnerships, and maintain strong sales performance. Care This role reports to senior leadership and includes line management of a Junior Key Account Manager. You will work closely across functions including Marketing, Technical, R&D, Culinary, Supply Chain

jobs.description: At Sanity.io , we’re building the future of AI-powered Content Operations. Our AI Content Operating System gives teams the freedom to model, create, and automate content the way their business works, accelerating digital development and supercharging content operations efficiency. Companies like SKIMS , Figma , Riot Games , Anthropic , COMPLEX , Nordstrom , and Morningbrew are using Sanity to power and automate their content operations. We’re looking for an empathic senior support engineer who thrives on solving complex technical challenges and helping customers succeed with Sanity at scale. As a senior member of the team, you will independently own high-impact issues, guide enterprise customers through complex implementations, and improve the systems, workflows, and documentation that power our support organization. This is not a reactive ticket-queue role. It requires strong technical judgment, calm communication under pressure, and the ability to turn recurring customer friction into lasting improvements. What you would do: Independently own and resolve complex technical issues for enterprise customers. Lead investigations into ambiguous or high-severity issues and liaise during incidents, maintaining clear communication throughout. Produce high-quality minimal reproductions, reusable code snippets, and structured issue reports. Nos clients se répartissent en trois familles : Générosité : faire donner (ONG, fondations, associations) Communauté : faire adhérer Impact : faire recourir à un service Notre organisation repose sur des pôles d'expertise, chacun avec son chef de projet dédié : Social : stratégie et animation des réseaux sociaux Design : identité, UX/UI, création Développement : sites, landing pages, intégrations Marketing : SEA, SEO et data Cette organisation garantit un haut niveau d'expertise sur chaque métier. Le poste de Directeur / Directrice de projets Grands Comptes a pour vocation de relier ces différentes expertises et d'assurer leur cohérence sur les accompagnements transverses mobilisant plusieurs pôles. LE POSTE Passionné(e) par la culture digitale et convaincu(e) du rôle essentiel des associations et ONG dans notre société, vous souhaitez mettre vos compétences au service de projets qui ont du sens ? Rattaché(e) au pôle Commerce, vous assurez le pilotage opérationnel global de quelques grands comptes stratégiques multi expertises, principalement des ONG et des associations, dont les accompagnements mobilisent plusieurs pôles d'expertise de l'agence. Véritable chef d'orchestre de ces comptes, vous en êtes le référent opérationnel en interne. Vous en maîtrisez les enjeux, l'historique et les priorités, et veillez à assurer une coordination fluide entre les différentes expertises, avec une vision partagée des objectifs et des engagements clients. Vous exercez une autorité fonctionnelle sur les chefs de projet métiers dans le cadre des projets transverses, notamment pour coordonner les interventions, arbitrer les priorités et garantir la cohérence globale des accompagnements, sans lien hiérarchique direct. VOS MISSIONS 1. Piloter les grands comptes et coordonner les expertises Être l'interlocute

Rattaché(e) directement au CFO Groupe En clair : une feuille blanche, un vrai mandat de builder. Vous ne reprenez pas un système existant, vous le créez, vous le modernisez, vous le simplifiez. jobs.title: Lead Acquisition B2C
jobs.description: Green-Got en bref Green-Got est une alternative complète et moderne aux grandes banques, du paiement à l'investissement. En finance, on ne construit pas à côté du système. Nous y prenons du pouvoir pour en changer la direction. Ce que nous refusons : nous excluons strictement l'expansion fossile, sur tous nos produits. Et notre assurance-vie et notre PER, c'est zéro financement d'entreprise dans le pesticide. Ce que nous dévoilons : ce que les banques traditionnelles font de l'argent de leurs clients. Et nous sommes transparents jusque sur nos propres limites. Ce que nous construisons : les paiements de nos membres financent des enquêtes, du lobbying et du plaidoyer qui s'attaquent aux causes. Les banques ont des lobbyistes ; nos membres en ont un aussi. Quelques repères : Plus de 3 milliards d'euros déjà passés par les comptes et les cartes de nos membres 150 M€ d'épargne sous gestion 15 millions d'euros levés auprès de notre communauté, à chaque fois en un temps record Pourquoi ce poste compte autant. Chaque compte ouvert envoie un message aux grandes banques : le marché a changé. Et plus nous grandissons, plus nous pesons. Notre ambition est assumée : devenir un actionnaire qui pèse au conseil des entreprises qui freinent la transition. Nous commencerons une fois le cap du milliard d'euros d'épargne franchi. Entre nos 150 M€ et ce milliard, il y a ton travail. Le poste Tu prends en main toute l'acquisition B2C haut de funnel de Green-Got : faire venir de nouvelles personnes sur notre app, et les amener à ouvrir un compte ou à investir. Tu as deux grands objectifs : les ouvertures de compte (compte + carte de paiement) et la collecte (investissement). Notre north star, c'est l'ARR : ce qui compte, c'est ce que tu rapportes vraiment à la boîte, pas le nombre de clics. Tu ne pars pas de zéro. Nos canaux existent et tournent déjà. Ton job : les reprendre, les améliorer, les scaler, et en inventer de nouveaux. Le budget que tu pilotes se compte en centaines de millier

jobs.title: People Operations & Payroll (Working Student)
jobs.description: People Operations & Payroll (Working Student) About the team At SumUp, our People Operations & Payroll team is the engine behind a smooth and reliable employee experience. We manage the full employee lifecycle — from onboarding and contract changes through to offboarding — while supporting accurate and timely payroll across Southern Europe. In France, recurring operational work is growing across employee lifecycle administration, field sales hiring and payroll coordination. You’ll join a hands-on, detail-driven team where operational excellence and employee care go hand in hand. The role This is a Working Student position supporting the People Operations & Payroll team in France. You’ll take ownership of recurring administrative and payroll support tasks, help keep our data accurate and up to date, and make sure employees and managers get timely, clear support. This is a great entry point into HR and payroll operations for someone who is organised, reliable, and eager to build real expertise in a fast-moving environment. What you’ll do Payroll support Help to collect, and organise payroll input data ahead of monthly deadlines Support follow-up with external payroll and benefits providers where relevant Help maintain accurate payroll records and flag missing information or discrepancies HR administration & employee lifecycle Prepare, update, and archive employment contracts and employee documentation Support onboarding, contract changes, and offboarding processes — ensuring data accuracy and completeness at every step Assist with benefits administration where needed Employee support & ticket handling Respond to routine employee and manager queries via internal systems and email with clarity and care Manage open tickets and follow up, escalating more complex cases when needed Data management & process improvement Maintain and update employee data in HR systems and Excel / Google Sheets trackers Perform regular data checks and keep Notion pages

jobs.title: Superviseur de Service Client Junior (H/F)
jobs.description: En bref Prêt(e) à piloter l’excellence du service client chez Picnic ? Dans une équipe constituée de 3 autres Superviseurs et sous la responsabilité de nos Managers des Opérations, tu encadres une équipe de 25 Chargé(e)s de clientèle et tu assures la fluidité de nos opérations sur tous nos canaux. Entre coaching, résolution de cas complexes et collaboration étroite avec les équipes en entrepôts, ton impact est immédiat. Une fois le quotidien maîtrisé, tu prends les commandes de projets transverses pour optimiser nos processus et réinventer l’expérience client. Tu veux passer à la vitesse supérieure ? Envoie-nous ton CV et rencontrons-nous ! Tes missions Encadrement des Chargé(e)s de clientèle : Recruter, former et encadrer une équipe diversifiée d’agents du service client pour garantir un service de qualité; Pilotage opérationnel quotidien : Assurer la fluidité du service sur tous nos canaux (WhatsApp, e-mails, appels), tout en garantissant un bon suivi des KPIs; Gestion de crise : Être le/la premier(e) interlocuteur(rice) sur les cas complexes, tu coordonnes les solutions avec les entrepôts pour transformer chaque incident en succès client; Exécution de projets d amélioration : Mener à bien des projets pour optimiser les performances de l équipe; Optimisation continue : Tu analyses les retours terrains pour améliorer nos processus internes et l ergonomie de notre application. Pour assurer une présence continue à nos clients tout en préservant ton équilibre, ton planning s’articule autour de trois rythmes : Shifts opérationnels : Soit au bureau de 8h à 16h , soit en télétravail de 15h à 23h . Shifts projets : Des journées au bureau de 10h à 18h pour te concentrer sur l amélioration de nos services. La présence week-end : Tu assures 3 week-ends par mois, intégralement en télétravail . À propos de toi Tu es titulaire au minimum d un diplôme de niveau Bac +2 en relation client, management ou autre domaine équivalent ; Tu disposes d une expérience de 1 à 3 ans en m

Évaluer la faisabilité et préparer l’industrialisation Étudier les modalités d’intégration avec la plateforme Convergence et contribuer à la définition d’une architecture cible. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d’ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street) et Dubai. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: De IT-afdeling van Den Hartogh (25 collega's) werkt als één team aan de groei en doelstellingen van ons familiebedrijf, verdeeld over clusters als IT Operations, Architecture & Security en Data Integration & Analytics. Als Data Engineer binnen dat laatste cluster help je de business proactief bij het behalen van haar zakelijke en financiële doelen, met data in de breedste zin van het woord. Via applicaties, dashboarding en ad-hocanalyses moderniseer je ons datalandschap, en er is volop ruimte om te innoveren met predictive & generative AI, Data Science en Process Automation (RPA) . Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de Teamlead Data Integration & Analytics. Wat ga je doen? Je slaat de brug tussen organisatie en processen enerzijds en techniek anderzijds; Als sparringpartner voor de business til je de managementinformatie naar een hoger niveau, in innovatieve en complexe dataprojecten; Je onderhoudt en breidt onze data pipelines in SQL uit en bouwt een semantisch model ; Je voert ad-hocanalyses uit met SQL (en R) en stimuleert continue verbetering via data- en procesanalyse; Je werkt nauw samen met data professionals om de bruikbaarheid van interne en externe data te verbeteren. Jij bent onze ideale kandidaat als je: Een bachelor of master hebt in Technische Bedrijfskunde, Business IT & Management, Data Science, Analytics of vergelijkbaar; Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring hebt in een vergelijkbare functie én minimaal 4 jaar met SQL ; Sterk bent in SQL, DAX, dimensioneel modelleren, data vault modeling, versiebeheer en Scrum ; Uitstekend communiceert in Nederlands en Engels (woord en geschrift) en een scherpe, kritische blik hebt, daarnaast durf je tegen de business aan te schuren; Proactief en resultaatgericht bent, met een sterke drive om te blijven verbeteren en jezelf te ontwikkelen; Pré : 2+ jaar ervaring met Machine Learning-modellen, geavanceerde Power BI-kennis en ervaring met het implementeren van AI-modellen in een organisatie. Wat bieden wij? Een salaris tussen € 4.00

jobs.title: Stage Bouw
jobs.description: Hé stage topper! Kom jij, net als vele andere stagiaires, stagelopen bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo? Bij ons krijg jij de kans om mee te denken, werken én ontwikkelen aan gave projecten binnen Noord, Midden en Oost-Nederland. Wij hebben weer volop stageplekken vanaf Februari 2027 op onze bouwen en op kantoor! Dit wordt jouw stage Als stagiair bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo ga je aan de slag op ons kantoor of op één van onze projecten. We kijken in overeenstemming welke afdeling of welk project het beste bij jou en/of de opdracht past. Tijdens je stage word je goed begeleid door één van onze collega’s en krijg je de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen! Jij staat aan het stuur van je eigen ontwikkeling tijdens je stageperiode: Hoe meer jij wil leren, hoe meer jij kan leren! Naast dat je zelfstandig aan een opdracht kan werken wordt je ook begeleidt door een senior collega die jou alle kneepjes van het vak gaat leren. We hebben door heel ons werkgebied verschillende bouwen waar we ruimte hebben voor een stagiaire, stuur ons vooral een berichtje zodat we samen kunnen kijken wat passend is! Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een familiebedrijf. Een onafhankelijke bouwonderneming actief in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek in Nederland. Al sinds 1855 vormen onze onafhankelijkheid en langjarige continuïteit de basis voor onze strategie. Met een omzet van circa € 1,8 miljard en ruim 3.000 medewerkers behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Samen realiseren we prachtige projecten. Iconische, en soms ook alledaagse projecten waarmee we nieuwe antwoorden bieden op maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Waarmee we de beste oplossingen voor morgen garanderen en het verschil maken voor Nederland, juist op de langere termijn. We hebben stevige ambities – en daarvoor geldt dat we die alleen kunnen waarmaken dankzij onze mensen. Als beste werkgever maken wij ons er daarom hard voor dat jij elke dag opnieuw kiest voor Dura Vermeer

Maar nieuwe technologie alleen maakt een team nog niet beter. Daarvoor heb je iemand nodig die mensen verbindt, samenwerking versterkt en verandering écht in beweging krijgt. Iemand die begrijpt dat Agile niet allen draait om ceremonies, maar ook om waarde toevoegen, wendbaarheid, eigenaarschap en samenwerking. Jouw rol Als Scrum Master begeleid je multidisciplinaire teams die werken aan complexe softwareprojecten, data-oplossingen en AI-first applicaties. Je helpt teams om beter samen te werken, obstakels weg te nemen en continu te verbeteren. Je bent een stevige gesprekspartner voor de organisatie, developers, product owners en stakeholders en weet wanneer je moet coachen, uitdagen of juist ruimte moet geven. Maar je kijkt ook vooruit. Wat betekent AI voor de manier waarop teams software ontwikkelen? Hoe kunnen AI-developmenttools en agentic workflows bijdragen aan kwaliteit, snelheid en samenwerking? jobs.description: Opleiding: Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bij voorkeur met een achtergrond in bedrijfskunde, economie, finance, commerciële economie of vergelijkbaar. Ervaring: Minimaal 5 jaar relevante ervaring binnen payments, banking, fintech, strategic partnerships of business development. Kennis: Van card schemes, issuing, acquiring en de werking van het internationale betalingsverkeer. Persoonlijkheid: Je bent communicatief sterk, organisatiesensitief, zelfstandig en overtuigend op senior niveau. Salaris: € 7.000,- en € 8.000,- p/m. WAT GA JE DOEN? Elke dag checken 6,5 miljoen Nederlanders in om te reizen met het OV. Met de OV-chipkaart, OV-pas, betaalpas, creditcard of mobiel. En dat werkt simpel en soepel. Kaart voor de lezer en … ‘bliep’. Reizen maar! Maar achter die ‘bliep’ gaat een complexe wereld schuil. Welkom in de wereld van Translink! Met de introductie van nieuwe betaalmogelijkheden onder de vlag OVpay is Translink dichter komen te staan bij de bredere financiële sector. In- en uitchecken met de bankpas vereist goede afstemming met banken. Maar ook de bredere inzet van EMV-technologie met OVpay maakt dat we als bedrijf te maken hebben met bestaande card schemes. Als Senior Partnership Manager Payments - Card Schemes & Banken, ben jij het externe gezicht van Translink binnen het paymentecosysteem. Je onderhoudt strategische relaties met onder andere Visa, Mastercard, banken en andere belangrijke partijen in het betalingsverkeer. Je begrijpt hun belangen en ontwikkelingen en weet deze te verbinden met de ambities van Translink en OVpay. Je beweegt je gemakkelijk op senior niveau en voert gesprekken met zowel inhoudelijke experts als directies en bestuurders. Daarbij begrijp je niet alleen de commerciële kant van partnerships, maar ook hoe de paymentketen inhoudelijk werkt. Je weet wat ontwikkelingen binnen issuing, acquiring en card schemes betekenen voor Translink en kunt deze vertalen naar concrete keuzes en afspraken. Intern werk je nauw samen met onder ander

jobs.title: Senior System Test & Validation Engineer
jobs.description: As a Senior System Test & Validation Engineer at Optics11, you are responsible for defining and driving system-level verification and validation for complex multidisciplinary products. You develop a strong understanding of the product, customer use cases, system architecture, operating environment, and technical risks, and translate these into effective validation strategies, test setups, and test campaigns. The systems you validate combine sensing hardware, embedded software, Edge computing, networking, cloud software, data processing, algorithms, and customer-facing applications. Your role is therefore focused on validating the complete system and ensuring that critical customer workflows work reliably before release. You work closely with Product, Systems Engineering, Software, Embedded, Hardware, Algorithms, Operations, Manufacturing, and other IVVQ engineers. This is a senior hands-on individual contributor role, combining system-level thinking, test design, technical investigation, and practical validation. Qualifications BSc or MSc in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, Embedded Systems, Physics, or a related technical discipline. 7+ years of relevant experience in system testing, verification & validation, integration testing, or product qualification. Experience validating complex multidisciplinary products combining hardware and software. Strong understanding of system-level test strategy, risk-based testing, requirements verification, and product qualification. Experience translating requirements and customer use cases into practical validation approaches. Experience designing system test setups and representative test environments. Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills across subsystem boundaries. Working knowledge of Linux and networking. Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, and modern engineering workflows. Experience with requirements traceability and verification evidence. Strong communication skill

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer (OptiArray)
jobs.description: Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on. Within our Underwater Security business we develop sensing technologies that help detect and monitor underwater threats. Insurance infrastructure is brutal to get right. Every carrier has its own spec, every product its own underwriting rules, every country its own regulatory requirements. Most insurers throw people and process at that complexity - one-off integrations, workarounds on workarounds. We're building it differently: our insurance platform is where we consolidate that complexity, so that launching a new product or market becomes a configuration exercise rather than a rebuild. Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by more than €40M from investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years we've expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance. About the role You would join the Shop team, responsible for everything that happens after a small business buys a policy from us. You would help shape how the platform handles the next product and the next country, on a system already carrying live policies and real customers. The team owns end-to-end policy lifecycle management (mid-term adjustments, automated renewals, cancellations, and payment flows) alongside the backoffice tooling that gives our operations and support teams full visibility and control. We work closely with the Claims Team, and with the Activation Teams that turn a lead into a paying customer. Product and engineering together are 30+ people. Every country has its own regulatory quirks, and every insurance product has unique data structures, lifecycle rules, and money flows. As we expand across Europe, our goal isn't to write custom glue code for every new launch. It's to design elegant, reusable platform abstractions. jobs.title: Rust Software Engineer - Rust / C++ (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Quantum Systems develops autonomous, multi-domain systems that operate in the air, on the ground and on the water. Behind every platform is software that has to work reliably in the real world, with limited resources, unreliable connectivity and no second chances. We are looking for software engineers who like to build exactly that kind of software in Rust and C++. You will join our engineering organization and work on production code that runs on real vehicles and sensors, across a broad range of challenges from low-level systems to scalable services. We are looking for engineers who quickly understand a complex system and its domain, and who use that understanding to get leverage: designing the architecture, setting the guardrails and guiding several AI agents at once to build, test and iterate faster, while taking full responsibility for the result. What is your Day to Day Mission: Build and maintain production-grade software in Rust and C++ for autonomous platforms and the systems around them. Design performant, fault-tolerant components that run on embedded Linux, edge hardware and in the cloud. Develop communication layers, data pipelines and real-time processing for sensor-driven, distributed systems. Work with hardware and robotics engineers to get software from simulation and test benches onto real vehicles. Use AI agents as part of your daily engineering workflow: break down problems, run several agents in parallel, review their output critically and make sure it meets our quality and safety standards. Own your code end to end: design, review, testing, deployment and troubleshooting of systems in the field. Shape architecture decisions and help raise engineering standards in a growing team. What you bring to the team: Several years of professional experience (ideally 4+) building software in Rust and/or C++, including production code. A strong foundation in systems programming: concurrency, memory and resource management, networking and performance tuning.

Mehr Verantwortung, mehr Gestaltungsspielraum, spannendere Projekte oder ein Arbeitgeber, der Qualität nicht nur fordert, sondern aktiv lebt? Dann sind Sie bei der PolyTALENT GmbH genau richtig. Als spezialisierter Personalberater für Fach- und Führungskräfte im industriellen Mittelstand unterstützen wir qualifizierte Experten dabei, attraktive Karrierechancen zu entdecken. Dank unseres umfangreichen Netzwerks in der produzierenden Industrie kennen wir die Anforderungen des Marktes genau und bringen die richtigen Persönlichkeiten mit den passenden Unternehmen zusammen – diskret, professionell und vertraulich. Wir suchen den Austausch mit Qualitätsexperten aus Bereichen wie: Qualitätsmanagement und Qualitätssicherung (QM/QS) Lieferantenqualität und Wareneingangsprüfung Reklamationsmanagement und 8D-Methodik Auditmanagement (ISO 9001, IATF 16949, ISO 14001 u. a.) Prozessoptimierung, FMEA, SPC und MSA Lean Quality, Six Sigma und KVP Messtechnik und Laborleitung Was Sie erwartet: Zugang zu attraktiven Positionen in renommierten Industrieunternehmen Diskrete Begleitung während des gesamten Prozesses Individuelle Karriereberatung, abgestimmt auf Ihre fachlichen Stärken und Ziele Ein starkes Netzwerk in Branchen wie Automotive, Maschinenbau, Kunststofftechnik und Metallverarbeitung So einfach geht es: Nehmen Sie Kontakt mit uns auf und lassen Sie uns Ihre beruflichen Ziele kennenlernen. Durch unser Netzwerk behalten wir interessante Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten für Sie im Blick und informieren Sie, sobald sich eine passende Perspektive ergibt. Sie möchten wissen, welche Möglichkeiten der Markt aktuell für Sie bereithält – ob als Qualitätsmanager, Leiter Qualitätssicherung oder Spezialist für Audits und Normen? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Kontaktaufnahme. Ihr Ansprechpartner PolyTALENT GmbH Andrej Stabel +49 1588 8630954 Find mor

jobs.title: Junior Product Manager:in
jobs.description: Über Valova Wir bauen die KI-Betriebsplattform für Europas Krankenhäuser, damit sich jede Ärztin und jeder Arzt auf die Patienten konzentrieren kann. Hinter jedem Fall steht eine Kette administrativer Aufgaben: Dokumentation, Kodierung, Abrechnung, Prüfungen, Planung. Sie läuft über getrennte Systeme und unzählige manuelle Übergaben, während die meisten deutschen Kliniken bereits rote Zahlen schreiben. Wir starten dort, wo der Effekt ab Tag eins messbar ist: vom Fall bis zum Geldeingang. Valova kodiert jeden Fall, verteidigt ihn in der Prüfung und sorgt dafür, dass das Geld ankommt. Von dort übernehmen wir jeden Workflow eines Krankenhauses, bis ein agentisches System die Routine erledigt und Menschen über Ausnahmen entscheiden. Erst Deutschland, dann Europa. Ein Team aus Ärzt:innen, Engineers, Strategieberater:innen und Start-up-Profis. Vor Ort in München und Berlin. Wir freuen uns auf dich! Warum diese Rolle wichtig ist Mit Valova kodieren Kliniken ihre Fälle schon heute deutlich schneller. Und das ist erst der Anfang: Wir bauen Valova Schritt für Schritt über die Kodierung hinaus aus, und jede Erweiterung muss im Klinikalltag funktionieren, nicht nur in der Demo. Genau hier kommst Du ins Spiel. Du findest heraus, wo Kodierteams Zeit und Erlöse verlieren, entscheidest mit, was wir als Nächstes bauen, und bringst es mit unserem Engineeringteam live. Du bist die Brücke zwischen Klinik und Code und zwischen unserem Team und den Menschen, die täglich mit Valova arbeiten. Was Du bewirkst, siehst Du schwarz auf weiß: in weniger Minuten pro Fall und in mehr Fällen, die Valova ohne Korrektur abrechnet. Deine Rolle im Team Du berichtest direkt an Malte, unseren Produkt Lead, und arbeitest täglich mit unseren Engineers zusammen. Fachlich arbeitest Du eng mit unseren Kodier- und Abrechnungsexpert:innen: Sie kennen die Regeln, Du machst daraus Produkt. In Klinikprojekten arbeitest Du Hand in Hand mit unserem Vertrieb und Customer Success und auf Klinikseite mit Medizincontrol

jobs.title: (Senior) B2G Manager: Public Sector & Research Funding (f/m/d)
jobs.description: “This is not your typical B2G role.” B2G sounds boring, until you realise it's money from the state and you own it. You'll be responsible for a big share of RIZM's funding sources, with real influence on RIZM's cash flow and on how fast we grow. You'll be tapping into new sources that most companies never even look at. Why this role exists RIZM builds RIZMO, an AI agent that makes energy decisions for industrial companies. Our next lever is the public sector: municipalities, utilities and economic development agencies have to implement heat plans, keep business parks competitive and relieve the grid. We're looking for someone to own B2G as a business line at RIZM, from public funding all the way to municipalities as paying customers. What you'll own Public funding as a growth channel. Forschungszulage (Germany's R&D tax allowance), EU grants, ERDF (EFRE) and other programmes: build the pipeline, actively own and track our running programmes, forge consortia and get applications approved. Connect research. Coordinate our research collaboration with Stanford and translate it into funded projects. Build the machine, AI-first. Set up your own systems, tracking and automation, so one person can run a funding pipeline that usually takes a whole team. You decide how the role works behind the scenes. Take over and scale ReNET-EV. Own our part of the ERDF project ReNET-EV (grid-friendly energy supply for business parks in the Münster/NRW region) and roll the model out to more municipalities. Turn municipalities into customers. Win cities, municipal utilities and economic development agencies that use RIZM for heat planning, climate strategy and business park development. Set up offers and procurement routes for the public sector. Orchestrate the ecosystem. Bring chambers of commerce (IHKs), economic development agencies, utilities and industry partners together in joint projects. Build the data foundation. Tap into public and municipal data that makes our models more precise

jobs.title: Rust Software Engineer - Rust / C++ (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Quantum Systems develops autonomous, multi-domain systems that operate in the air, on the ground and on the water. Behind every platform is software that has to work reliably in the real world, with limited resources, unreliable connectivity and no second chances. We are looking for software engineers who like to build exactly that kind of software in Rust and C++. You will join our engineering organization and work on production code that runs on real vehicles and sensors, across a broad range of challenges from low-level systems to scalable services. We are looking for engineers who quickly understand a complex system and its domain, and who use that understanding to get leverage: designing the architecture, setting the guardrails and guiding several AI agents at once to build, test and iterate faster, while taking full responsibility for the result. What is your Day to Day Mission: Build and maintain production-grade software in Rust and C++ for autonomous platforms and the systems around them. Design performant, fault-tolerant components that run on embedded Linux, edge hardware and in the cloud. Develop communication layers, data pipelines and real-time processing for sensor-driven, distributed systems. Work with hardware and robotics engineers to get software from simulation and test benches onto real vehicles. Use AI agents as part of your daily engineering workflow: break down problems, run several agents in parallel, review their output critically and make sure it meets our quality and safety standards. Own your code end to end: design, review, testing, deployment and troubleshooting of systems in the field. Shape architecture decisions and help raise engineering standards in a growing team. What you bring to the team: Several years of professional experience (ideally 4+) building software in Rust and/or C++, including production code. A strong foundation in systems programming: concurrency, memory and resource management, networking and performance tuning.

jobs.title: Rust Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Rust Engineer Location: Berlin and surrounding At Deepslate, we are building Speech to Speech Voice AI models that sound and act indistinguishably from a human. And we believe everyone should be able to use them. With its endless languages, dialects, accents, subtle intonations, and speech melodies, voice remains a highly complex unsolved frontier. That is exactly why we started Deepslate. Backed by top-tier investors from the Tech and AI sectors, as well as a major German VC fund, we are incredibly well-funded and moving fast. We are building the future of communication. We aren't trying to build another standalone platform; instead, we are the intelligence engine powering countless other applications. Whether it's integrated as a module by a CRM provider, plugged into another Voice AI platform, or directly embedded into an enterprise system by our integration partners, our model is built to work wherever it is needed. Your Role Many core parts of our model stack are written in Rust. At the heart of it is our inference engine, written entirely in Rust. Your mission is to build and improve these systems. You will work on the inference engine, take ownership of other Rust projects, and help decide how everything fits together. We need someone who enjoys writing good Rust code and can design software that stays understandable and maintainable as it grows. Our models need to respond in real time. The software you build will directly influence how fast and reliable they are in an actual conversation. What You'll Do Build in Rust: Develop our inference engine and other core components of the model stack. Take projects from the first architectural decisions to running in production. Design the Architecture: Decide how components and services communicate, where responsibilities belong, and how we can extend the system without making it harder to work on. Work on Real-Time Systems: Build async Rust systems that handle concurrent workloads and streaming audio with low latenc

Modern distributed systems are increasingly complex, with multiple interconnected components, services, and autonomous agents interacting in dynamic environments. Ensuring their cybersecurity requires analysing potential attacks, understanding the strategies available to attackers and defenders, and verifying that critical security properties are preserved. Formal verification provides rigorous methods for addressing these challenges, allowing engineers to reason about system behaviours and establish mathematical guarantees. However, applying these techniques to realistic systems remains challenging. Verification problems can involve large state spaces and complex strategic interactions, while constructing formal models and specifying security properties often requires specialised expertise. The VITAMIN-C (VerIficaTion of A MultI-ageNt system for Cybersecurity) project aims to address these challenges by combining formal verification with artificial intelligence. Building on VITAMIN, an existing modular model-checking platform for multi-agent systems, the project develops methods and tools for analysing cybersecurity properties in distributed and autonomous systems. Attackers and defenders are represented as agents with specific capabilities, objectives, and available actions. Their interactions are analysed using attack graphs, temporal and strategic logics, and model-checking techniques. The project also investigates how AI can improve the efficiency and accessibility of these verification processes. Their interactions are analysed using attack graphs, temporal and strategic logics, and model-checking techniques.
